$comment: Network policy for the Rapid7 InsightIDR MCP container.
This container holds an API key to our security platform and runs community
code at version 0.1.0. Those two facts together are the reason egress is
restricted to the one host it legitimately needs: if the code misbehaves or
a dependency is compromised, the credential has nowhere to go.
eu.api.insight.rapid7.com matches INSIGHTIDR_REGION=eu. Changing the region
means changing this host too - the server would otherwise fail closed, which
is the correct direction to fail.
Not the authorization boundary. What the agent may DO in Rapid7 is decided
by ToolHive tool admission (only annotated read-only tools are exposed) and
by the permissions on the API key itself. This file only limits where
The API key should be scoped read-only in the Rapid7 console as well. That
is the equivalent of the IAM boundary for AWS, and it is the layer that
holds if ToolHive is ever misconfigured. Tracked as a prerequisite rather
than assumed: see docs and config/versions.yaml.
